text:
marta: quick question — auditors want a tiny contextual clue in the console graph that shows who flipped routing policies during a rollout. currently we only show the policy id and timestamp, which isn't enough for compliance reviews :eyes:

alex: we have that info in the audit export (actor + justification + rollout_id) but we intentionally didn't surface it in the hovercard because of space/PII concerns. what are the exact audit fields they need to see in-console vs in export?

samir: ideally: actor display name (not full email), actor role, change reason, rollout id/version, and a link to the audit export bundle if available. do we need more?

marta: that's the ask. compliance wants a one-click path from the graph node -> audit record. they also want a way to redact emails in the UI for non-admins.

neil: proposal: add 2 new small UI fields to node tooltip: `actor_hint` and `justification_snippet`. actor_hint = display name or team tag (e.g., "Alyssa (policy team)"). just a hint, click expands into the full audit detail pane which is gated by role.

alyssa: +1. we should also note in telemetry when someone expands the full audit detail (so product can track auditors usage). we already have an event for "audit_export_download" — add "audit_detail_view" with rollout_id and redaction_mode.

marta: important: redaction_mode should be either `none`, `masked`, or `obfuscated_email`. masked = show initials, obfuscated_email = show first char + ****@domain. admin sees full.

alex: backend implications: our current policy-change event looks like:

```
{
  "event_type": "policy_change",
  "policy_id": "route-123",
  "actor": { "id": "u_789", "email": "alyssa@redwood.ai", "display": "Alyssa" },
  "justification": "hotfix: fallthrough to cheap-model",
  "rollout_id": "r_2026_07",
  "timestamp": 2790013456
}
```

alex: we can add `actor_hint` (string) and `redaction_mode` (enum) to the UI payload without changing the canonical export shape. exports remain full unless customer config says redact.

samir: caution: some customers consider display names PII too. we should tie display exposure to the tenancy policy (private vs hosted) and to role. default hosted tenant: mask non-admins.

neil: for implementation plan: (1) add `actor_hint` computed field at ingest layer, (2) emit a tiny `console_audit_summary` alongside the node graph API, (3) build tooltip that shows hint + truncated justification + link to audit pane, (4) add telemetry event when expanded.

marta: UX notes: keep tooltip height small, show a subtle :lock: icon if details are gated. show "View audit" as a secondary link. also support keyboard nav for screen readers.

alyssa: can we include an inline mini-diff for policy changes? like `from: allow -> to: deny` in one line. very helpful for reviewers.

alex: doable for simple attribute changes. complex diffs might require a modal with full export. one-line diff generator at ingest looks cheap.

devops-bot: FYI — created feature branch `feat/audit-tooltip` and a draft PR at https://git.redwood/feat/audit-tooltip (open for comments).

marta: timeline? compliance team would like a demo next Wed.

samir: estimate: backend + ingest changes (2 devs, 4 days), frontend tooltip + pane + telemetry (2 devs, 3 days), QA + roles gating (1.5 days). we can aim for next Tue to demo if we start tomorrow.

neil: security: let's add an audit log entry when tooltip reveals full actor details so we can prove who viewed sensitive info. wire it to existing audit channel.

alyssa: one more ask: make sure the export bundle includes the `actor_hint` and `redaction_mode` fields in a `console_summary.json` at the root of the export so auditors using the console can match the hover context to the exported NDJSON.

marta: that solves both UX and export correlation. thanks all — i'll sync with compliance and post followups. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: export-ready-checklist: [actor_hint present] [redaction_mode present] [rollout_id present] [audit_detail_link present] — PASSED

marta: closing loop: PR linked above, will leave a small TODO to add the one-line diff generator to ingest pipeline.

neil: sounds good. i'll review the PR today.

alex: i'll start the ingest patch after stand.

samir: i'll put a small acceptance test in the export pipeline to assert `console_summary.json` appears in bundles.

alyssa: will prepare compliance demo notes and sample redaction screenshots.

marta: perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
